    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get song and artists
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            song_title = parts[0].strip()
            rest = parts[1].strip()

            # Extract artists (before " RELEASED_AT")
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_str, released = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
                released = released.strip()
            else:
                artists = [a.strip() for a in rest.split(',')]
                released = None
            songs.append({
                'title': song_title,
                'artists': artists,
                'released': released
            })
